title: Spicy Harvest Relish
preamble:
Ingredients:-
1medium
Onion diced
1Courgette
diced
2
Plums
1stick
Celery, diced
1teaspoon
Ginger
1teaspoon
Garlic
1teaspoon
Sugar
Water,
splash or two
1tablespoon
Vinegar
1
Apple, diced
1
small Chilli, chopped

Method:-
Soften your diced onion and celery in a pan with a little oil for 8 minutes.
Add chopped chilli and garlic and ginger in the oil for 30 seconds.
Stir in the diced courgettes, apples, and plums.
Add a splash of water, a splash of vinegar, a pinch of salt, and a teaspoon of sugar.
Simmer... cook gently for 30 to 60 minutes until thick, glossy, and beautifully spicy.
